code: sim_covariates <- function(n) {   tibble::tibble(x1 = stats::rnorm(n), x2 = stats::rbinom(n, 1, 0.4)) } calibrate_censoring <- function(Tt, target) {   if (target <= 0) return(0)   f <- function(c) mean(exp(-c * Tt)) - (1 - target)   if (f(1e-6) < 0) return(1e-6)   hi <- 1e-6   while (f(hi) > 0 && hi < 1e6) hi <- hi * 2   stats::uniroot(f, c(1e-8, hi))$root } dgm_weibull <- function(n, beta, shape = 1.3, rate = 0.15, cens_rate = 0.3,                         x = NULL) {   if (is.null(x)) x <- sim_covariates(n)   lp <- as.numeric(beta["b1"] * x$x1 + beta["b2"] * x$x2)   U <- stats::runif(n)   Tt <- (1 / rate) * (-log(U) / exp(lp))^(1 / shape)   crate <- calibrate_censoring(Tt, cens_rate)   Cc <- if (crate <= 0) rep(Inf, n) else stats::rexp(n, crate)   time <- pmin(Tt, Cc); status <- as.integer(Tt <= Cc)   list(data = tibble::tibble(time = time, status = status, x1 = x$x1, x2 = x$x2),        lp = lp) } surv_weibull <- function(t, lp, shape, rate) exp(-((rate * t)^shape) * exp(lp))

text: published model developed large cohort; coefficients baseline hazard fixed thereafter (“externally validate” means). clinic’s pre-specified deployment gate (fixed seeing local data): () adequate discrimination, Harrell C ≥ 0.65; (ii) acceptable calibration, slope [0.80, 1.25]; (iii) positive clinical value, net benefit threshold 0.2 beats treat-/none.
code: HZ  <- c(3, 5); H5 <- 2L; TAU <- 5; PT <- 0.20  # threshold for the decision DEV_BETA  <- c(b1 = 0.70, b2 = -0.50) DEV_SHAPE <- 1.3; DEV_RATE <- 0.14 set.seed(2026) dev <- dgm_weibull(4000, beta = DEV_BETA, shape = DEV_SHAPE, rate = DEV_RATE,                    cens_rate = 0.35)$data published <- coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ x1 + x2, data = dev, x = TRUE, y = TRUE) C_MIN <- 0.65; SLOPE_LO <- 0.80; SLOPE_HI <- 1.25  baseline_at_horizons <- function(bh, horizons) {   ok <- is.finite(bh$time) & is.finite(bh$hazard)   time <- bh$time[ok]   hazard <- bh$hazard[ok]   if (!length(time)) return(rep(0, length(horizons)))   ord <- order(time)   time <- c(0, time[ord])   hazard <- c(0, hazard[ord])   keep <- !duplicated(time, fromLast = TRUE)   time <- time[keep]   hazard <- hazard[keep]   if (length(time) == 1L) return(rep(hazard[[1]], length(horizons)))   out <- stats::approx(time, hazard, xout = horizons,                        method = "constant", rule = 2, f = 0)$y   out[is.na(out)] <- 0   out }  published_predict <- function(fit, newdata, horizons) {   Terms <- stats::delete.response(stats::terms(fit))   mf <- stats::model.frame(Terms, newdata, xlev = fit$xlevels)   X  <- stats::model.matrix(Terms, mf, contrasts.arg = fit$contrasts)   X  <- X[, names(stats::coef(fit)), drop = FALSE]   eta <- as.numeric(X %*% stats::coef(fit))   bh  <- survival::basehaz(fit, centered = FALSE)   H0  <- baseline_at_horizons(bh, horizons)   list(eta = eta, S = exp(-outer(exp(eta), H0))) } metric_dnb <- function(pt, h) function(draw, w) {   nb <- net_benefit_draw(draw, thresholds = pt, horizon = h, w = w)   c(NB_model = nb$model, dNB = nb$model - max(nb$all, 0)) } oracle_worthy <- function(loc_beta, loc_rate, N = 5e4) {   ref <- dgm_weibull(N, beta = loc_beta, shape = DEV_SHAPE, rate = loc_rate,                      cens_rate = 0)   pp  <- published_predict(published, ref$data, HZ)   Strue  <- surv_weibull(HZ[H5], ref$lp, DEV_SHAPE, loc_rate)   risk_t <- 1 - Strue; risk_p <- 1 - pp$S[, H5]   oC  <- concordance(Surv(ref$data$time, rep(1, N)) ~ I(-pp$eta))$concordance   osl <- unname(coef(coxph(Surv(ref$data$time, rep(1, N)) ~ pp$eta))[["pp$eta"]])   odds <- PT / (1 - PT); pos <- risk_p >= PT   f <- mean(pos); r <- if (f > 0) mean(risk_t[pos]) else 0   nb_m <- if (f > 0) f * r - f * (1 - r) * odds else 0   r_all <- mean(risk_t); nb_all <- r_all - (1 - r_all) * odds   odnb <- nb_m - max(nb_all, 0)   list(C = oC, slope = osl, dNB = odnb,        worthy = (oC >= C_MIN) && (osl >= SLOPE_LO && osl <= SLOPE_HI) && (odnb > 0)) } suite <- list(   harrell = metric_harrell_c,   uno     = function(d, w) metric_uno_c(d, w, tau = TAU),   slope   = metric_cal_slope,   ici     = function(d, w) metric_ici(d, w, horizon = H5, method = "auto")["ICI"],   ibs     = function(d, w) metric_brier(d, w)["IBS"],   nb      = metric_dnb(PT, H5))

code: with_preserved_rng <- function(expr) {   old <- if (exists(".Random.seed", .GlobalEnv))            get(".Random.seed", .GlobalEnv) else NULL   on.exit(if (!is.null(old)) assign(".Random.seed", old, envir = .GlobalEnv))   force(expr) } paired_boot_gate <- function(time, status, lp, surv2d, B, seed) {   n <- length(time)   with_preserved_rng({     set.seed(seed)     pass <- logical(B)     for (b in seq_len(B)) {       idx <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE)       tt <- time[idx]; ss <- status[idx]; ll <- lp[idx]       ch <- tryCatch(concordance(Surv(tt, ss) ~ ll), error = function(e) NULL)       cs <- tryCatch(coxph(Surv(tt, ss) ~ ll), error = function(e) NULL)       if (is.null(ch) || is.null(cs)) { pass[b] <- NA; next }       Cb  <- 1 - ch$concordance                      # marker orientation = -eta       slb <- unname(coef(cs))       db  <- list(surv2d = surv2d[idx, , drop = FALSE], eta = ll, time = tt,                   status = ss, horizons = HZ, n = n, H = length(HZ))       dnbb <- as.numeric(metric_dnb(PT, H5)(db, rep(1 / n, n))["dNB"])       pass[b] <- (Cb >= C_MIN) &&         (slb >= SLOPE_LO && slb <= SLOPE_HI) && (dnbb > 0)     }     mean(pass, na.rm = TRUE)   }) } # Wilson score interval for a binomial proportion (uncertainty band on each # reliability-bin empirical fraction). wilson_ci <- function(k, n, z = 1.96) {   if (n == 0) return(c(lo = NA_real_, hi = NA_real_))   p <- k / n; d <- 1 + z^2 / n   ctr <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / d   hw  <- z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / d   c(lo = max(0, ctr - hw), hi = min(1, ctr + hw)) }

what: D-calibration (per draw) — A2.6, Haider et al. (JMLR 2020).
